name: 编辑 ZsRE 事实知识
description: 使用 ROME 方法在 ZsRE 数据集上进行事实知识编辑，精确修改模型中的特定事实记忆。
description_en: Edit factual knowledge on ZsRE dataset using ROME method. Precisely modify specific factual memories in the model.
constraints: 数据需要包含 prompt/subject/target_new/target_old 字段
ROME 方法对模型架构有特定要求
constraints_en: ROME method has specific model architecture requirements
risk_notes: 连续编辑可能导致模型性能下降
建议先在小规模数据上测试
risk_notes_en: Sequential edits may degrade model performance
Test on small data first is recommended
prompt_hints: 当用户需要精确修改模型中的单个或少量事实时推荐。ROME 方法效率高，适合事实级别的编辑。
prompt_hints_en: Recommend when user needs to precisely modify single or few facts in the model. ROME is efficient for fact-level editing.
